name: Artificial Sandwich Intelligence
tagline: A low-cost robot arm that learned to make a sandwich from teleoperated demonstrations.
problem: Sandwich shops depend on repetitive manual assembly, the builder says.
solution: A transformer policy based on Action Chunking with Transformers, trained on about four hours of teleoperation data on one GPU, controls a roughly USD 200 open-source arm to assemble a sandwich, compared against a human benchmark.
demo_moment: Team-described: the arm builds a sandwich on video alongside a human attempt.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Cites the research method and compares against a human.
A solo builder won the grand award with a physical robot.

lessons: Reproduce a recent research result on cheap hardware and show it working.
